messages:
maria: vuln-bot flagged CVE-2026-4251 (jinja2 sandbox escape) — PoC linked in feed. EPSS ~0.82, CVSS reported 9.1. Any owners for services using jinja2?
secops-bot: vuln-bot: New advisory -> CVE-2026-4251; affected: jinja2 < 3.1.3; reference: https://oss-advisories.example/CVE-2026-4251
dan: svc-render likely affected, we vendor templates there. @olga is svc-render owner, tagging.
olga: confirmed svc-render pinned to jinja2 3.1.1 in poetry.lock. I'll do a dependency smoke check, ETA 45m.
sujay: quick exploitability check: PoC requires ability to supply templates with arbitrary objects + access to environment attributes. Do we allow untrusted user templates in onboarding/email flows?
maria: yes — onboarding templates accept user-provided snippets for advanced customers. We sanitize but not fully sandboxed. Risk = high for that codepath.
olga: marking svc-render P0. Will inventory other services that import jinja2.
dan: mitigation path: bump to 3.1.3 or apply runtime hardening. @patchbot can you open a dependency bump PR for svc-render and any other direct consumers?
patchbot: PR created -> repo: redwood/svc-render #4213 bump jinja2 to 3.1.3; CI triggered.
olga: running tests locally, then will push to staging canary (10% traffic) if green. Will include smoke checks for template rendering errors.
maria: triage notes for record: base CVSS 9.1, EPSS 0.82, exploit PoC public -> exploitability = high; priority = immediate patch + canary rollout.
sujay: telemetry ask: check request logs for unusual template payload sizes or repeated render failures from same IPs last 7 days. Also check exec attempts in container logs.
dan: add audit logs capture for template evaluations: route to sec-logs with structured fields (user_id, template_id, render_result, error). Keep 90d retention for now.
olga: adding audit log emitter to svc-render: event = templating.render {outcome, template_hash, user.id}. Will include correlation id.
sujay: KMS/RBAC note: templates sometimes pull secrets via internal secret-ref. Ensure KMS key usage checked; rotate if any suspicious access.
maria: OK actions: (1) olga = bump & canary + audit logs, (2) dan = create incident ticket + update dependency inventory, (3) sujay = telemetry/exploit search + KMS access review. I'll loop in legal if we see customer impact. :thumbsup:
olga: starting work now — pushing branch and test results in ~30m. Commands I'm running:
```
# local repro
pip install 'jinja2==3.1.3'
poetry update jinja2
pytest tests/unit/template_* -q
```
patchbot: will post CI status here when green/failing.
secops-bot: incident created -> INC-2026-2337; link: https://incidents.example/INC-2026-2337
maria: thanks team — please add short postmortem note on incident when resolved.
olga: will update thread with canary status and rollback instructions if needed.
